newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet prices slip, but diffs hold steady.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet prices slip, but diffs hold steady.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices weakened slightly Tuesday, led by the dip in NYMEX futures prices.
However, differentials showed little movement as activity remained fairly lackluster with few barrels changing hands during the day.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel for the front 1st cycle was offered at 2.75 cents under the screen, while 2nd cycle barrels were offered at about 2.85 cents under.
New York Harbor 54-grade material was talked between 1.60 and 2.00 cents over the screen.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
